name: @w6w-apps/dropcontact
description: Enrich and verify B2B contacts with Dropcontact: submit batches, poll or force results, read credits, and manage the default webhook.

w6w.longDescription:
Dropcontact finds and verifies business email addresses and enriches B2B contacts and companies: civility, qualified emails (nominative, generic, catch-all), phone, job level and function, company website, LinkedIn, SIREN/SIRET, VAT, NAF code, headcount and turnover.

Enrichment is asynchronous. A workflow submits up to 250 contacts as one batch and gets a request id back, then either polls for the result (Dropcontact asks for roughly 30 seconds between polls), asks for whatever is ready so far, or lets Dropcontact call a webhook when the batch is done. A single-contact action wraps the submit-and-poll loop and can wait for the answer inside the step. The remaining credits are readable without spending any.

The connection holds a Dropcontact API access token, sent in the X-Access-Token header. Dropcontact charges on success only: a credit is spent when a verified email is returned or when an email you supply is verified.
